claims.text:
stage computation: Same scalar Q=w, terminal targets from trajectory[1,1,−1,−1], w0=0, eta.5 update w←w+.5*(target−w). Chronological4 updates produce[.5,.75,−.125,−.5625]. Declared replay index order[0,2,1,3] produces[.5,−.25,.375,−.3125]. Common evaluation uses all four original targets: mean squared error=1+w², hence1.31640625 versus1.09765625.

**Countercase / boundary:** A different with-replacement replay sample indices[0,0,0,0] gives w=.9375, evaluation error1.87890625, worse than chronological. Both use four updates; with-replacement reuse is explicit. These selected sequences do not establish expected replay improvement or eliminate correlation automatically.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether reshuffling can change finalw under finite constant steps; recall reversing chronological targets produces+.5625 with same error, while replay may oversample one record.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Run one update shows buffer index, target, old/neww; Choose replay order and Repeated sample show all4 steps and retained evaluation errors. Distinguish data collection order from training order and count reuse per record.
